Vacancy for Healthcare Professionals
Monday, 11 May 2020
4371 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Wardha invites applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data with necessary experience certificates/testimonials for the following posts for Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Melghat. The scanned copy of all documents must reach the office of the Secretary latest by
22/05/2020
. Applications would be accepted on
email ID only (
secretaryoffice@mgims.ac.in
)
. No need to send the hard copy of application.
1. Gynaecologist
2. Paediatrician
3. Anaesthesiologist
4. General Duty Medical Officer
Required Qualification:
Posts (1 to 3): MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree/Diploma in concerned subject. For post 4: MBBS.
Candidates with previous experience of working in a hospital, Out-patient and Inpatient departments, M.J.P.J.A.Y. and Community Health Services shall be preferred.
Salary:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
